queries.upbit: SELECT date_bin('1 hour',ts,TIMESTAMPTZ '1970-01-01') AS hour_start,(array_agg(open ORDER BY ts))[1] AS hour_open,(array_agg(close ORDER BY ts DESC))[1] AS hour_close,count(*) AS source_rows,count(DISTINCT ts) AS distinct_timestamps,min(ts) AS first_ts,max(ts) AS last_ts FROM bars_upbit WHERE symbol=:symbol AND interval='1m' AND ts>=:start AND ts<:end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
